'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***A [[rocket]] attack from [[Lebanon]] on a military base in [[Safed]], [[Israel]], kills one [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldier]] and injures several others. In response, [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in southern Lebanon kill 11 civilians and four [[Hezbollah]] militants in [[Nabatieh]] and [[al-Sawana]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/feb/14/seven-civilians-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-south-lebanon (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Ukraine]] claims to have [[List of ship losses during the Russo-Ukrainian War|sunk]] the [[Russian ship Tsezar Kunikov|Russian ship ''Tsezar Kunikov'']] off the coast of [[Katsiveli]], [[Crimea]]. A video appears to show the vessel being struck with [[unmanned surface vehicle|unmanned surface drones]]. [https://www.svoboda.org/a/ukraina-nanesla-udar-po-rossiyskomu-desantnomu-korablyu-tsezarj-kunikov-/32818938.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**Two [[Chinese people|Chinese]] fishermen drown and two others are rescued when their boat capsizes near [[Kinmen]], [[Taiwan]], while being pursued by the [[Coast Guard Administration (Taiwan)|Taiwan Coast Guard]], who allege that the fishermen were trespassing. [https://apnews.com/article/china-taiwan-kinmen-fishermen-deaths-bb1136fda2bdc3cd5e696692d24e070d (AP)]
*Explosions occur along the route of a [[natural gas pipeline]] from [[Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari province]], [[Iran]], to the [[Caspian Sea]]. The Iranian oil minister blames the incident on "terrorism and sabotage". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-main-gas-pipeline-hit-by-sabotage-oil-minister-says-2024-02-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Port Hills fire]]
**A [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[Christchurch]], [[New Zealand]], as firefighters attempt to control a [[bushfire]] in the city's [[Port Hills]] region. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/nz-news/350179673/port-hills-fire-live-helicopters-grounded-blaze-continues-night (''Stuff'')]
*Fifteen people are killed and eight others are injured when a truck and four microbuses collide in [[Alexandria]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/egypt-road-crash-deadly-alexandria-semitruck-microbuses-15829f7346fcd3c7aa0a66f11cd90393 (AP)]
*One person is killed and 53 others are injured when a church balcony collapses during an [[Ash Wednesday]] [[Mass in the Catholic Church|Mass]] in [[San Jose del Monte]], [[Bulacan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/church-balcony-falls-in-philippines-during-prayer-leaving-one-dead-and-53-injured-690147 (WION)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]], [[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] officials announce a "serious national security threat" after [[military intelligence]] indicates that [[Russia]] intends to imminently place [[nuclear weapon]]s in space. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] has been briefed, according to officials. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2024/02/14/russia-is-preparing-to-launch-nuclear-weapon-into-space/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**The U.S. holds emergency talks with allies, including [[Canada]] and the [[United Kingdom]], on the Russian nuclear threat. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/us-russia-security-concern-canada-allies-1.7115633 (CBC)]
**[[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Mike Johnson (Louisiana politician)|Mike Johnson]] says that there is no need for public alarm after briefing President Biden on the matter. [https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4468159-speaker-johnson-on-national-security-threat-there-is-no-need-for-public-alarm/amp/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Cuba]], [[Foreign relations of South Korea]]
**[[Cuba]] and [[South Korea]] establish [[diplomatic relations]] after exchanging letters via their [[United Nations]] representatives. [https://www.reuters.com/world/south-korea-establishes-diplomatic-ties-with-cuba-north-koreas-old-friend-2024-02-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War crimes in the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***The [[Hostages and Missing Families Forum]] files a complaint of [[war crimes]] against the leadership of [[Hamas]] at the [[International Criminal Court]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/families-of-israeli-hostages-to-file-war-crimes-complaint-against-hamas-in-the-hague/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[2024 Kansas City parade shooting]]
**One person is killed and 22 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] during the [[Kansas City Chiefs]]' [[Super Bowl LVIII]] championship parade at [[Kansas City Union Station|Union Station]] in [[Kansas City, Missouri]], [[United States]]. Three armed suspects are arrested at the scene. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/shooting-reported-kansas-city-after-chiefs-super-bowl/story?id=107238682 (ABC News)]

**[[Indonesians]] elect a [[President of Indonesia|president]] and [[Vice President of Indonesia|vice president]], members of the [[People's Consultative Assembly]], and local representatives. '''Science and technology'''
*An over 10,000-years-old underwater structure from the [[Stone Age]] is discovered in the [[Bay of Mecklenburg]], in the [[Baltic Sea]]. The kilometer long stone wall might be the oldest man-made structure on earth. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/12/world/baltic-sea-hunter-gatherer-megastructure-scn/index.html (CNN)]
